summary: {official} learns that a drinking fountain a seated visitor can use may still leave someone unable to bend without a drink.
realLife: At the Germino Building on the Los Banos Fairgrounds, inspectors found an accessible fountain but no option for people who had difficulty bending.
gates: A building survey finds a low fountain and no drinking option at standing height.
inGame: needs: the building's drinking points, use heights and approach clearance.

turns.what: The reviewer asks how seated visitors will get water.
turns.pulledBy: A replacement plan removes the low unit.
turns.writesBack: The plan goes back with both needs recorded.

turns.what: The reviewer checks the approach to each.
turns.pulledBy: The design offers drinking points at both heights.
turns.writesBack: The facility file records both drinking locations.
